Good to know

Before your appointment.

Is the hair really included?

Yes. Every braided style comes with the hair, so you just show up. Bringing your own bundles for a quickweave or specialty color? That is welcome too.

How do I book, and what is the deposit?

Booking stays on my Acuity, quick and simple. A small non-refundable deposit holds your spot and goes toward your service; the balance is due at your appointment.

How should my hair be prepped?

Freshly washed, blown out straight, and detangled, no products or oils. Hair should be about four inches all around. Not sure? Message me first and we will sort it out.

What is the cancellation policy?

Life happens. There is a short grace period, and one reschedule with the same deposit in the same month. A no-call, no-show is the only thing I cannot hold a spot for.

Where are you located?

Atlanta, 30315 (Lakewood). The exact address is sent 24 hours before your appointment, so you never have to chase it down.
